svg.title: Разведение рук на заднюю дельту лёжа на животе — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. BODYWEIGHT PRONE REAR-DELTOID ARM RAISE on FLAT bench. Both figures lie FACE DOWN, chest and belly supported on bench. NO DUMBBELLS, NO WEIGHTS in hands. Elevated rear three-quarter view shows flat bench support. Left: arms relaxed hanging below shoulders. Right: arms raised directly sideways to shoulder level, with slight elbow bend, shoulder blades gently drawn together. Hands open/empty. Feet behind on floor. Torso remains prone on bench, never a standing bent-over fly. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
